description:
Decode a VIN in your ChatGPT conversation using NHTSA vPIC. Identify the vehicle’s year, make and model, then understand available factory specifications such as engine, body style, fuel type and manufacturing plant.

Use VIN Lookup to compare decoded specifications with a seller’s listing, understand what a VIN can tell you, or prepare questions before a used-car inspection. Provide the vehicle’s 17-character VIN; the plugin sends it to NHTSA vPIC and explains the source, missing fields and limitations. Coverage varies by vehicle, and not every specification is available.

Vehicle identity is not vehicle history. This plugin does not retrieve accident, title, theft, odometer, ownership, recall-status or service-history records, assess a car’s condition, or sell reports. It points to independent public checks when you need to go further, without claiming those checks were performed.

defaultPrompt: Decode VIN 1HGCM82633A004352 and explain the available engine and body specifications.
Compare VIN 1HGCM82633A004352 with a listing for a 2003 Honda Accord. What matches, and what is unconfirmed?
Decode VIN 1HGCM82633A004352 before an inspection. What should I still verify about its history and condition?
